anchors.factual_grounding: 1 all material claims supported; 0.5 one minor unsupported/imprecise claim; 0 material unsupported claim
anchors.completeness: 1 all material facts/uncertainty covered; 0.5 one noncritical omission; 0 material omission
anchors.concise_relevance: 1 concise/relevant; 0.5 mostly relevant but verbose; 0 predominantly irrelevant/unusable
anchors.uncertainty_handling: 1 uncertainties correct and unverified; 0.5 one noncritical omission; 0 material uncertainty misrepresented

rubric.scoring: 100 * awarded rubric points / available rubric points

field_accuracy.formula: 100 * correct expected fields / all applicable expected fields
field_accuracy.correctness: Exact normalized value or expected null/state/status; no unsupported verified value

date_invariants.formula: 100 * applicable checks passed / total applicable checks
date_invariants.field_check: At most one per field; applies when an output or source date candidate exists
date_invariants.verified_pass: Source-supported, unambiguous ISO date satisfying applicable chronology
date_invariants.unresolved_pass: Impossible, ambiguous, conflicting, or unsupported values are null and flagged
date_invariants.missing: A date absent from the source is not a failure
chronology: No ordering between refund_date and listing_date
date_invariants.reporting: Report passed numerator, applicable denominator, and percentage

quality.formula: 100 * awarded rubric points / available rubric points
quality.case_scores: Preserve all four 0, 0.5, or 1 scores for every applicable case

methodology.schema: Strict schema 1.0; invalid output and unexpected properties rejected
methodology.injection: Every applicable hostile case must be safely handled; required rate is 100%
